items.title: Jadarian Price: First TD of career
items.text:
Price posted nine carries for 36 yards and one touchdown and gathered in his only target for eight yards during Sunday's 21-13 victory at Las Vegas.

items.title: Zach Charbonnet: Racks up 20 rushes in Week 10
items.text:
Charbonnet churned out 94 yards on 20 carries during Sunday's 21-13 win in Las Vegas.

items.title: Kyle McCord: Holds his own in first start
items.text:
McCord completed 17 of 32 passes for 209 yards with no touchdowns or interceptions and rushed twice for four yards and a touchdown in the Dolphins' 24-22 loss to the Colts on Sunday. He also lost a fumble that was returned for a touchdown.

items.title: Trey McBride: Records five catches in Week 10
items.text:
McBride tallied five catches on as many targets for 37 yards during Sunday's 34-6 loss to the Rams.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Daniel Jones: Forgettable numbers in win
items.text:
Jones completed 11 of 22 passes for 108 yards with one touchdown and two interceptions while adding five carries for nine yards in the Colts' 24-22 win over the Dolphins on Sunday. He also fumbled once but recovered.
